# Heartbeat of South Bay

> Managed AI Revenue Systems for service-based businesses: structured lead intake, approved follow-up workflows, missed-call recovery where scoped, and CRM visibility.

Heartbeat of South Bay builds and manages AI systems — lead intake, approved follow-up workflows, CRM integration, and reporting — for local service businesses. Based in the South Bay (Los Angeles), serving the United States.
